start.text: Back on the fen you see it before anything else: out at the end of the long walk, where the boards stop, a small light sits low over the water. It doesn't move. It doesn't go out.
The lantern that was lit at the fog's foot when the Heron took. Somebody has carried it this far in, and set it down.
That's not one of mine. Nobody walks that far out with a light. Nobody ever did.
